description: Translate the IceDevimon, Arukenimon, and Pharaohmon story sequence in MESPAK02 entry 7.

english: Fine! Then I'll beat you by force!!
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: Guh...! How could I lose to brats like you...?
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: IceDevimon! Lies won't help you! If you don't understand that, you'll never beat us!
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: Heh... Hahahahaha! Is that so?
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: What did you say?!
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: Lies and cheating... Sometimes they can be a source of power, too!
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: Exactly... Just as light casts a shadow, even shining strength needs darkness...
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: W-will I really be reborn as the strongest...?
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: Yes... Your 'cunning' data is essential to the new being. Bring everything together in the Omega Area!
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: Ah... Ahh...! A-a-aah...!
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: The Omega Area...? What is that?
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: Will we learn everything if we go to Earth Fort...?
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: Taiki, Shoutmon! Let's hurry to Earth Fort! The Omega Area... Something about that name sounds really bad...
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: Sounds bad...? How bad? Like when a teacher's about to scold you?
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: ...I don't know. When I remembered the name Dynasmon, my heart felt warm... But the Omega Area... That name fills me with fear. It's cold and unknown...
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: ...I'm sure the key to Spadamon's memories is there, too. Let's hurry to Earth Fort!
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: Heh heh... Boys, you've finally made it here.
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: You're Arukenimon...! You controlled Sparrowmon back then!
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: Sparrowmon was a special gift from Lord Zeed Millenniummon... I haven't forgotten that humiliation!
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: Don't talk about our friend like she's an object!
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: Heh heh heh... Is that what you call your burning friendship?
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: Ugh, you make me sick! If you're going to use junk data anyway, you might as well let Lord Zeed Millenniummon use it. She was being controlled, so she probably didn't feel a thing!
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: Arukenimon... You're awful!
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: Next, you'll be a present for my lord! What color ribbon should I tie around your shredded bodies? Pink, perhaps? How exciting! I'll put you out of your misery soon!
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: You...!! I'll never forgive you! Never, ever, ever! I won't forgive you!!
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: S-she's scary...
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: ROG, the legendary weapon, everything! I'll offer it all to Lord Zeed Millenniummon!!
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: H-hey, Arukenimon...!
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: No matter how many times I crush it, Elestou Zone rises again! Cursed Dynasmon...!
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: Dynasmon...? You know that name?
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: Heh heh heh... I know why Spadamon lost his memories!!
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: What?!
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: And the reason is...!
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: Arukenimon, I admire your cruelty, but your loose tongue is your greatest flaw...
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.
Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: Damn it, Zeed Millenniummon! He erased her to shut her up!
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: Dynasmon, the legendary warrior who wielded the legendary weapon and managed Capacitor Tower... Is he connected to my memories...?
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: The legendary ancient weapon... Dynasmon, who could wield it... Spadamon's memories... And the Omega Area... I don't understand... But right now, we must not break the seal on the legendary weapon! That's all I know! Let's hurry to Earth Fort!
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: I never thought we'd meet again! No need for introductions, I am Pharaohmon! I am ROG's Shining Leader, Pharaohmon the Grave!
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: Huh...? Isn't that Anubismon?
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: Doesn't he need a pyramid to transform?
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: Then this should be easy!
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: How disappointing that you didn't notice I was holding back! Now I'll show you my true power... and the great calamity I can unleash!
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: Grrr...! This is so frustrating! How can Pharaohmon lose to a bunch of upstart kids with no titles after fighting so hard?!
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: We're Team Xros Heart! We just can't leave people suffering right in front of us!
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: Xros Heart... It's like a heart burning with passion...
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: ...Ah, yes. I haven't lost yet.
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: That's right, Pharaohmon. This is only the beginning. If you join with us, you will have nothing to fear. No worries, doubts, or pain. Give me your 'obsession' now...
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: Very well... Take it all! Crush us to pieces and turn us into the strongest being!
blocks.review_note: Direct dialogue translation with continuous scene context. Canonical Digimon names, established zone names, and the project's ROG terminology are retained.

english: Team Xros Heart...! We will rise again! And when we do, we'll crush you for good!!
